_readme: MAP-AUTHORED HALLS — chapters listed here build their museum halls FROM the named grid maps (in order): tile from the map's structure (h>=2 wall, h==1 floor, cropped to content), artifacts at their map cells, plinth = height 2 under the anchor. Applied to em_plan.json by `python tools/em_map_halls.py --apply` (backup kept, shipped copy follows); the museum skips the necklace hand's stamp-clear for these rows — the map is the placement authority. Remove a chapter to return it to the dealt plan on the next apply.
